description:
RecordMaster inspired by the Google Pixel Recorder app, but with more features
Features:
• ✨ More features will be added in future updates.
• 📁 Folder Organization: Create and manage folders to keep your recordings sorted.
• ✏️ Easy Renaming: Rename recordings on the fly for better organization.
• 🔗 Quick Sharing: Share recordings instantly through apps, messaging, or cloud services.
• 🕒 Timestamped Files: Automatically save recordings with date and time metadata.
• 🔊 Playback Controls: Adjust speed, skip silence, and navigate smoothly.
• 🗑️ Trash Bin: Recover deleted recordings before they’re permanently removed.
• 📤 Export Options: Save recordings in multiple audio formats (MP3, WAV, etc.).
• 🔍 Search Tool: Find recordings by name, date, or folder.
• ☁️ Local-Only Mode: All recordings stay on your device unless you choose to share them.
